# Repository Tooling

## Purpose

- Own repository-hosted prompts and future automation configuration.

## Ownership

- Keep prompt files focused on reusable repository workflows.
- Runtime application behavior is owned by the root script, `includes/`, and `plugins/`.

## Local Contracts

- Do not encode runtime requirements only in repository prompts.

## Work Guidance

- Preserve the format expected by the consuming GitHub or editor feature.

## Verification

## Child DOX Index

- No child DOX files.
